content: Hi, I work in retail and want sales and inventory analysis skills — could you tell me about the SMU Academy's SCTP Advanced Certificate in Data Communications and Visualisation for Business Analyst, like its content, duration and full fee?

(SCTP) Advanced Certificate in Data Communications and Visualisation for Business Analyst (SF-007), SMU Academy.

Data visualisation, data preparation, charts, storytelling, dashboards and a capstone. Tools include Tableau, Excel and Python libraries. The published duration is 330 hours over three months; this is not the hypothetical six-month programme.

Published full fee: S$20,928. Duration: 3 months, 330 hours.

Confirm additional costs, intake and study timetable with the provider. Personal funding eligibility is unknown.

Official source: https://academy.smu.edu.sg/courses/sctp-adv-cert-data-comm-and-visual-biz-analyst
